copy.heading: Scope
body: This manual applies to any person who has acquired a garden through purchase of a property, inheritance, or the decision of another member of the household. It does not apply to persons who wanted one.
Where a garden has been acquired deliberately, the subject is outside the scope of this document and beyond the sympathy of its authors.
